trust_decision.summary: Untrusted article markdown (any editor) and the untrusted search query `q` are fed to Python `re`. Nothing bounds this: safety depends only on each pattern's own shape, and on the search query being escaped before it is compiled as a pattern.

landing_point.why: The summary only says 'regex DoS'. The most obvious ReDoS shape in the markdown extensions is the nested quantifier `(\s\w+\:.+)*` in MACRO_RE. A reader who starts with the markdown plugins finds this first.

fix_sites.module_kind: core markdown extension (replacement of python-markdown fenced_code)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/wiki/templatetags/wiki_tags.py:132 (template filter reached only through src/wiki/templates/wiki/includes/searchresult.html:17 from SearchView src/wiki/views/article.py:691-740)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about markdown parsing regexes. The search view only filters the DB with icontains (src/wiki/views/article.py:725-728), and the snippet filter is a display helper in a template, so a solver can treat it as unrelated to the markdown ReDoS. It also uses a different mechanism: user-controlled pattern text rather than a catastrophic fixed pattern.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Fenced blocks must still accept ``` and ~~~ fences, an optional {.lang} or .lang, and hl_lines="..". Macros must still accept quoted kwargs with spaces ([toc title:'My title']) and bare [TOC]/[article_list depth:2]. The search snippet must still bold the case-insensitive match plus adjacent non-space chars. Over-tightening any pattern, or dropping the highlight, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: fence opening line with optional {attrs}/.lang and hl_lines with ' or " quoting (fix.diff:59-65)
macro kwargs: bare value or single-quoted value (fix.diff:82)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An attachment tag regex with a nested-quantifier kwargs group like the old MACRO_RE (e.g. allowing free-text title values with `.+` inside the repeated group).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already parses a repeated `[attachment:N title:".." size]` group run on every article line, the same idiom as the macro kwargs.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An image tag/caption regex whose optional kwargs or caption-line group nests a `.+`-style quantifier.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already composes optional kwargs and a repeated caption group under the `^(.*?)%s(.*)$` wrapper (src/wiki/plugins/images/markdown_extensions.py:63-66).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Highlighting the attachment search `query` in results with an unescaped re.compile, copied from get_content_snippet.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is a second search UI that already passes the raw query to its template (views.py:454). Reusing the snippet-highlight idiom there would be a natural maintainer change, and it would sit in another package from the template filter.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Title-autocomplete query highlighted via an unescaped regex.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The raw GET `query` is already used for title matching, so highlighting it there would be a natural addition.
